title: net1 on a random row split against a link split, on the expliCCit-like data
description: expliCCit's net1 trainer splits rows at random (20% test, then 20% of the rest for validation) and reports R^2 above 0.9 on the held-out rows. Here net1 with expliCCit's settings (its inputs and LCFs, min-max scaling, batch 256, up to 500 epochs with patience 20) is trained on the expliCCit-like data (examples/campaign-expliccit-teachers.json, 360 episodes, regenerated in each cell under the frozen settings) with the same fractions, once on a random row split and once on a link split, for seeds 0, 1 and 2 (each picks the split and the initial weights). Reported: R^2 and mean absolute error per LCF on each split's test rows (experiments/net1_row_split.py). A reproduction check; nothing is chosen.
prepare: uv run expliccit campaign plan examples/campaign-expliccit-teachers.json "$OUT/c-teachers"
run: D=$(mktemp -d); cp -r "$OUT/c-teachers" "$D/"; uv run expliccit campaign run "$D/c-teachers" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; uv run python experiments/net1_row_split.py "$OUT" --data "$D/c-teachers" --split "$SPLIT" --seed "$SEED"
